scientific_integrity: General theorem follows from explicit simplex-cover intersection patterns, the natural nerve lemma, homotopy pushouts, and an equivariant integral Mayer–Vietoris isomorphism. Finite checks are separately identified as consistency tests, not proofs of the universal quantifier.
scientific_limitations: Applies to odd cycle lengths at least five, to induced restrictions of the ordinary open neighborhood complex, and to the natural dihedral action. A general sphere-suspension homotopy statement was previously known. The original Csorba full text was inaccessible for comparison; novelty risk remains. Intrinsic homology of every proper restriction and all automorphisms are not classified.
title: Vertex-essential two-spheres in neighborhood complexes of odd-cycle Mycielskians
